scope: 22 primary memory-matrix papers plus 6 independent FFN-mechanism papers with verified formal CVPR/ICCV/ICLR/NeurIPS 2025–2026 proceedings; 9 appendix entries.
transport: web search for discovery; direct HTTPS retrieval of primary pages, official PDFs and author-linked README files; no third-party implementation executed.
important_limitations: HTTP 200 alone was not accepted: page title and venue metadata were checked.
Author arXiv accepted comments do not establish independently verified venue status.

Seven memory-matrix priority papers (Frame2Freq, FreqKV, FlashCache, FluxMem, OASIS, AKS, LSDBench/RHS) and three independent FFN papers (Skip-Vision, Too Late to Recall, ParamMute) have selected official-PDF method sections reviewed; remaining mechanism descriptions are formal-abstract level.
C1 verifies accessible author README and documented commands, not installed dependencies, downloaded weights, complete licenses or reproduced scores.
Some search-result candidate arXiv IDs or repository URLs pointed to unrelated or unavailable resources and were excluded.

ffn_mechanism_matrix.title: Skip-Vision: Efficient and Scalable Acceleration of Vision-Language Models via Adaptive Token Skipping
ffn_mechanism_matrix.limitation: Includes training and adaptive summary tokens; not evidence of training-free FFN skipping or episodic video memory in frozen Qwen3-VL.

ffn_mechanism_matrix.title: Too Late to Recall: Explaining the Two-Hop Problem in Multimodal Knowledge Retrieval
ffn_mechanism_matrix.limitation: Static entity factual recall, not episodic video memory; distinguishes MLP and attention through attribution and activation patching.

ffn_mechanism_matrix.title: ParamMute: Suppressing Knowledge-Critical FFNs for Faithful Retrieval-Augmented Generation
ffn_mechanism_matrix.limitation: Text RAG suppression plus trained adaptation; not a training-free video memory method.

ffn_mechanism_matrix.title: Distributional Associations vs In-Context Reasoning: A Study of Feed-forward and Attention Layers
ffn_mechanism_matrix.limitation: Controlled synthetic tasks and Pythia; not a universal FFN-versus-attention division theorem.

ffn_mechanism_matrix.title: MLP Memory: A Retriever-Pretrained Memory for Large Language Models
ffn_mechanism_matrix.limitation: Additional retriever-trained MLP; does not establish new-video writing into frozen FFN parameters.

ffn_mechanism_matrix.title: NerVE: Nonlinear Eigenspectrum Dynamics in LLM Feed-Forward Networks
ffn_mechanism_matrix.limitation: Eigenspectrum/covariance geometry differs from video temporal Fourier frequency; variance reinjection is not short-action recovery.
